state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports precision/recall/F1 for detecting incorrect claims with ChatGPT as both examiner and examinee: 85.1/70.7/76.7 on LAMA, 82.8/71.6/76.8 on TriviaQA, 74.5/74.9/77.7 on NQ and 83.6/77.1/80.2 on PopQA for a single run. The majority-of-three-examinations variant gives F1 of 80.8, 82.6, 79.1 and 85.4.
title: ChatGPT cross-examining ChatGPT: about 77-80 F1 for detecting false claims
